info.title: Nodeboard API
info.description: Boards, cards, links, backlinks and the graph. Every response is filtered by the caller's role (spec §7): items on boards the caller cannot see are omitted, and requests for them return 404.

bearer.description: API token (dev seed: dev-ksenia, dev-alex, dev-sam, dev-casey)

shareToken.name: X-Share-Token
shareToken.description: Secret share link token (read-only); add X-Share-Password when the link has a password

get.summary: Workspaces where the caller can see at least one board
Graph of everything the caller can see
get.description: Server version of buildGraph() (src/model/graph.ts). Links to items the caller cannot see are dropped; links to deleted or missing items become `broken:` nodes.

parameters.name: tagNodes
parameters.description: Add a node per tag with tag edges

boardId.description: Board the item lives on (parent for boards); null when that board is hidden from the viewer

post.summary: Save a named graph view (GraphSettings from src/model/types.ts)

get.summary: A board with the cards, placements and connectors the caller can see
Workspace members and the overrides set on this board (owners only)

put.summary: Set or clear (role: null) a user's override on a board and its subtree (owners only)

post.summary: Create (or rotate) the secret view-only link for a board (owners only)

patch.summary: Enable/disable a share link, set or clear its password (owners only)

get.summary: One card, with its placements on boards the caller can see

put.summary: Create or update a card; re-indexes its links and tags in the same transaction
put.description: Editors only. To create, pass `type` and `boardId` (the board to place it on; for a new board, its parent). Text is stored as sent: send links in stored form `[[@id]]`.

boardId.description: Board to place a new card on (required when creating; the parent for a new board)

delete.summary: Move a card to the trash (soft delete; its links turn broken)

get.summary: Linked references to a card from items the caller can see

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Filter by source title, board or snippet

get.summary: Unlinked mentions: plain-text occurrences of the card's title (max 50)
Comment thread on a card or board

post.summary: Comment on a card or board (commenters and up); links in the body are indexed

get.summary: Full-text search over titles and text (Postgres FTS; Meilisearch can replace it later)

parameters.name: workspace
parameters.description: Default: every workspace the caller can see
